config.schedule: schedules=['combined']; interleaved uses ae_prob=0.5, combined uses CE + 2.0*recon on every batch; linear/frozen/mlp are pure task either way; AE hidden layers DETACHED from the task gradient, so the two schedules coincide and lam acts as an encoder-decoder lr multiplier
config.loss_recon: MSE between reconstruction and input (NAN: mean over batch x neurons x pixels; ANN: mean over batch x pixels)
config.learning_rule: BULL-FAITHFUL: hidden layer trained by reconstruction ONLY; the task gradient stops at the hidden/head boundary, so the encoder is never updated by cross-entropy. Applied to AE variants only — mlp/linear/frozen keep their usual training. NOTE: with disjoint parameter sets the interleaved and combined schedules coincide, and `lam` acts as an encoder-decoder learning-rate multiplier rather than a task/recon trade-off.
config.init: PyTorch defaults for Linear; NAN/ANN decoders kaiming_uniform (models.py)
config.eval: full test set after every epoch
